name: knight-bridge
description: Transfer completed Chess.com games to Lichess

scripts.build:all: wxt build -b chrome --mv3 && wxt build -b edge --mv3 && wxt build -b firefox --mv3
scripts.release: wxt zip -b chrome --mv3 && wxt zip -b edge --mv3 && wxt zip -b firefox --mv3 && node scripts/release.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:all && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts *.ts *.json docs README.md .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts *.ts *.json docs README.md .github
